query:
SELECT
            id              AS "id: MessageId",
            group_id        AS "group_id: GroupId",
            sender_id       AS "sender_id: SentinelIdentity",
            message         AS "message: GroupMessageContent",
            published_at    AS "published_at: DateTime<Utc>",
            read            AS "read: bool"
        FROM j2j_messages
        WHERE group_id = ?1
        ORDER BY published_at ASC
